title: tracker approve --json
description: An approve that went ahead (DESIGN.md §2.7): from an interactive terminal, after the ID was typed and every gate passed again. The item is done, verified by a human. A refused or cancelled one prints the error shape instead, and a gate that fails leaves the item in review with exit 2.

gates.description: Every gate that ran again, all of which passed.

item.description: The item after the approve, exactly as its file holds it.
